reasoning: This is a highly specific fire offering (homa) ritual from the private Ogyen Choling estate collection (Bumthang, Bhutan), combining Lama Drakpo Kilaya + White Tara Wish-fulfilling Wheel for purification. Lotsawa House fire offerings exhaustively searched — no such combined text exists there. No English translation found across EAP105 digitization project, academic literature, or web searches. The collection (Karmay's 'Diamond Isle' catalogue, 2003) has never had ritual texts translated for publication. BDRC full-text and WorldCat inaccessible, introducing uncertainty.
